rationale: This Science and Technology Studies (STS) paper examines discursive metaphors in the development of a regional healthcare patient portal and information infrastructures. It is completely unrelated to household or community water or sanitation service access (fails Criterion 1 and Criterion 4; primary exclusion code E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both readings because the study examines healthcare information infrastructures (a regional patient portal) rather than household or community water or sanitation service access (E01).

evidence_quotes.quote: We explore the role of two metaphors for innovation and infrastructure integration in the development of a regional patient portal.
Drawing on our formative study of the portal project, we focus on the generative character of metaphors and argue that they are constitutive elements of information infrastructures.
